say: ChatGPT takes on Claude, with two lives each.
Claude punches out its dots while ChatGPT inhales.
They trade punches and kicks up close, and both of them fall off the page.
Down to one life each, they parry each other's attacks.
Claude's dots keep finding ChatGPT, and its health drops by half.
Even ChatGPT's compaction can't turn it round.
ChatGPT goes over the edge, and Claude wins with most of its health left.
